Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1254
Claimant:
Marcus Davidson
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
03/28/2023
Claim opened for a parking lot collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck while stationary. The claimant
reports neck and back strain and is represented by counsel, so all contact will be routed through the attorney's office
from this point forward.
05/15/2023
Reviewed the photorgaphs submitted with the first notice of loss. They confirm several details of the scene and the
position of the vehicles, though no independent witnesses have come forward to describe the collision itself. The
damage to the vehicle appears consistent with the impact described.
06/18/2023
Obtained the policy record, which names the driver involved as a listed driver. Coverage was in force at the time of
loss, and there is nothing in the file to suggest the damage predates the start of the policy period. No prior damage to
the vehicle is on record.
07/25/2023
Spoke with the claimant's representative. The claimant's account of the event has remained the same in every
conversation so far. The police report and statements from others on scene place the claimant inside the vehicle at
the time of impact.
07/27/2023
Medical records reviewed. The reported injuries fit the type and force of the collision well, and no earlier injury to the
same area of the body is known. Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as the claimant improved.
09/02/2023
Based on the medical and physical evidence, the claim appears consistent with the reported loss. File will move to
evaluation of the bodily injury component, with the attorney's office copied on the next status update.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
